_comment: Patch deep-merged onto the server's current /api/settings/compression, then PUT back. Deliberately conservative: 'lite' + session-dedup only. Lite's default tool-result truncation (2000 chars) is OFF because it silently chops Claude Code file reads; caveman rewrites user prompts (lossy) and OmniRoute's rtk engine overlaps with the RTK Bash hook, so both are OFF. Expect ~9% input-token savings, not 50-90%. Prior config is saved to compression-settings.bak-pre-kit.json.
